meta.title: Danmaku ambience
meta.description: Streams short lines across the window in one of four moods — workaholic, zen, encourager, or companion — each with its own pacing, copy, and color. Pick a mood from the capsule at the bottom right.

panel.title: Danmaku mood
capsule.label: Danmaku: {mode}
settings.title: Danmaku
settings.description: Ambient lines drift across the window. Turn them on here; pick a mood from the capsule at the bottom right.
phrase.workaholic.0: The progress bar will not move itself.
phrase.workaholic.1: Not the time for a phone break.
phrase.workaholic.2: Five minutes now is ten tomorrow.
phrase.workaholic.3: You have a few too many tabs open.
phrase.workaholic.4: Stop switching windows. I am counting.
phrase.workaholic.5: This one takes twenty minutes. Start.
phrase.workaholic.6: That "almost done" was half an hour ago.
phrase.workaholic.7: Make it run before you make it pretty.
phrase.workaholic.9: What will you leave behind today?
phrase.workaholic.11: You have been sitting here a while.
phrase.workaholic.12: Do not rewrite it. Get it green.
phrase.workaholic.13: What you dodge now returns tonight.
phrase.workaholic.14: Focus is not a gift. It is this next choice.
phrase.workaholic.15: Close three tabs. You know which ones.
phrase.workaholic.16: Nobody is going to review a file that does not exist.
phrase.workaholic.17: Write the test. Then you may celebrate.
phrase.workaholic.18: The hard part is the next ten minutes.
phrase.workaholic.20: Your future self is watching this commit.

phrase.encourager.1: This part was hard. You got through it.
phrase.encourager.2: Stopping is not quitting. It is charging.
phrase.encourager.4: Do not fear the refactor. You know it better now.
phrase.encourager.5: You are clearer than when you started.

phrase.encourager.9: Take your time. You are on the right path.
phrase.encourager.10: Look at you, solving another one.
phrase.encourager.13: Easy now. Errors are information too.
phrase.encourager.14: You are more reliable than you think.
phrase.encourager.17: Not giving up is rare. Well done.
phrase.encourager.18: Breaking it small. You are already doing it.

phrase.companion.2: Let us think about this together.
phrase.companion.4: Want to put on some music?

phrase.companion.14: Look out the window when you look up.
phrase.companion.19: The lamp is still on. So am I.
phrase.companion.20: You do not have to talk. Just work.

phrase.workaholic.22: Small step now, or a long night later.

phrase.workaholic.32: The bug is a liar. Test it.
phrase.workaholic.33: Time is a resource with no refunds.
phrase.workaholic.34: Respect the deadline you set yourself.

phrase.zen.12: Let the next line be enough.
